entries.locked_in: The office door locked behind us. The timer on the wall is running.
entries.restore_power: Most of the office is dark. Some devices are not responding.
entries.investigate_pc: Dr. Mertens' PC is reachable again. It may contain traces of his final work.
entries.storage_room: The door to the adjacent room is open. Another part of the office lies beyond the keypad.
entries.escape: We have gathered enough clues to reconstruct Mertens' final steps. Now only the way out remains.

entries.mertens_missing: Dr. Elias Mertens has been missing for 72 hours. His research at Ciphera Labs was considered highly confidential.
entries.suspicious_contacts: Before his disappearance, Mertens reported unusual access attempts and suspicious contact requests.
entries.office_ransacked: The office was ransacked. Someone was apparently searching for Mertens' project files.
entries.trust_carefully: Some messages feel unusually urgent or manipulative. Not every source seems trustworthy.
entries.mythos: The name "Mythos" appeared in connection with Mertens' research. Its meaning is still unclear.

entries.power_switch: There was a hidden switch beneath a stack of papers. It activated the PC and parts of the lighting.
entries.login_needed: The PC is powered on, but locked.
entries.mail_review: Mertens' emails and blog posts give insight into the contacts shortly before his disappearance.
entries.virus_warning: The PC was infected by a suspicious file. Unknown downloads are apparently risky.
entries.control_panel: A file connected to the control panel appeared on the USB drive.

entries.door_code: A decrypted email contained the code for the adjacent room.
entries.trash_note: A note in one of the trash cans contained part of the PC login credentials.
entries.decoder_shelves: The bookshelves contain conversion tables and decoders for different notations.
entries.profile_paper: A profile sheet about Dr. Mertens gives context about his work and identity.
entries.final_code: The torn clue has been reassembled. It contains the final code.

entries.search: There are several USB drives in the office. One of them seems connected to Mertens' work.
entries.color_hint: A note refers to the relevant USB drive indirectly through a color.
entries.use_on_pc: The recovered USB drive was checked on the PC.
entries.recover_data: The USB drive or the PC contains traces of Mertens' hidden data.

entries.free_notes: Player notes are stored in the currently selected QuestLog tab.

settings.controls_description: Use the mouse to find interactables, then press [key code=$1] to interact!
settings.inventory_description: In the inventory, use [key code=$1 type=mouse] to use an Item
